inputs.text: Bloomberg keeps pushing the narrative that rising energy prices, grounded flights, and nonstop images of chaos mean the world is demanding an immediate end to the war against Iran, calling it badly planned and a threat to global stability. Yet even they have to concede this isn't true in Israel, where the public stands firmly behind continuing the fight to the end. This highlights the strength of true national resolve over weak global hand-wringing. Israeli citizens are supporting their leaders to complete the mission and safeguard their homeland, families, and way of life rather than yielding to progressive demands that favor weakness and disorder. That's the backbone we ought to value and uphold.
